annotations.title: Current time in any places or time zones

description: Use when the user asks what time or date it is right now somewhere. Reads the server clock and returns the current time, date, UTC offset, abbreviation and daylight saving status for each place. Places can be cities ("Tokyo"), IANA zones ("Europe/Paris"), abbreviations ("PST") or "UTC+5:30".

places.description: Cities, IANA zones or abbreviations, e.g. ["London","Asia/Tokyo"].

name: meridian_now
title: Current time in any places or time zones
